tytul: Akcje serwisowe aut w UE – tydzień 46/2026: Ford, Porsche
lead: Wezwania samochodów do serwisu zgłoszone w unijnym systemie Safety Gate w 46. tygodniu 2026 r. – 2 pozycji.
tresc:
## Do uzupełnienia

Szkic bez tekstu – brak klucza modelu językowego. Opisy usterek poniżej są po angielsku: przetłumacz je w panelu przed publikacją.

zrodla.nazwa: Safety Gate – raport tygodniowy Report-2026-46 (Komisja Europejska)

pozycje.problem: The wiring harness in the engine compartment may have insufficient abrasion protection. As a result, the sheathing of the wiring harness can wear down, which can expose the internal wires, causing a short-circuit and a fire. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
pozycje.zalecenie: Type of economic operator taking notified measure(s): ImporterCategory of measure(s): Recall of the product from end usersDate of entry into force: 06/11/2026

pozycje.problem: Defective bolts on the wheels may cause the centre-lock wheel nut to fracture. As a result, the wheel could come off, increasing the risk of accidents and injuries. The product does not comply with the Regulation on the approval and market surveillance of motor vehicles and their trailers, and of systems, components and separate technical units intended for such vehicles.
